# 绳道馆 (SDG188)

> > A Chinese-language resource sharing community forum powered by Discuz! platform with member-only access

绳道馆 (Sheng Dao Guan) is a members-only forum community focused on resource sharing. The site requires user authentication for most content access and operates on the Discuz! forum platform with hosting on Tencent Cloud infrastructure.

## Key Topics

- Discuz! forum platform
- Resource sharing (资源分享)
- User authentication and membership
- Chinese-language community
- Login-required content
- Forum threads and discussions
- User profiles and registration
- Access control and permissions
- Tencent Cloud hosting
- Browser compatibility (Google Chrome, Edge)
- Community membership management
- Forum sections and categories
- Restricted access content

## Forum Sections

- [Forum Section 53](https://www.sdg188.com/forum-53-1.html): Forum section requiring login authentication for access
